# Community conduct

Discuss ideas and code respectfully. Harassment, threats, discrimination and publishing
another person's private information are not acceptable. Do not post credentials or private
logs in issues, pull requests or discussions.

Keep bug reports reproducible and feedback focused on behavior and changes that can be made.
Maintainers may remove abusive content or restrict participation to keep the project usable.
For a sensitive conduct report, ask maintainer B23101 for a private contact without publishing
the incident details. Security issues follow the separate SECURITY.md reporting procedure.
